Name: Anthro Farmer
Author: Kangkatoo0707
Description:
Since this is the first mod I’ve ever made, I hope you won’t be too harsh on me. I welcome any bug reports or suggestions for the mod.

This mod was inspired by mods that turn all villagers into anthropomorphic animals. Why can’t our farmer character look like that too? This simple mod was born from that idea.

I created this on my own, so there may still be many parts that haven’t been thoroughly tested for bugs. I appreciate your understanding.
